about.en: WeFi builds on-chain financial infrastructure for what it calls deobanks: account architecture, stablecoin-backed balances, custody and compliant settlement, built on its WeChain stack, that let a fintech or institution offer payments, cross-border transfers, card spending and savings without exposing the underlying blockchain to its users. WFI is the project's token, the BEP-20 contract 0x90c48855Bb69f9D2C261Efd0D8C7F35990F2dd6f on BNB Chain. It is a different project from WeFi Finance (WEFI), the leveraged-vault protocol at wefi.xyz.
